newsitem.title: UK: Nomura sets BIPS on four Far East benchmarks.
newsitem.headline: Nomura sets BIPS on four Far East benchmarks.

text.p: Nomura International Plc said it had issued 1.90 million BIPS (Benchmark Index Participation Securities), on four different countries including Hong Kong, Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand.
BIPS are designed to track the performance of a benchmark index, including net dividends which will be re-invested in the index.
There are 275,000 BIPS on Hong Kong, 400,000 BIPS on Malaysia, 375,000 BIPS on Singapore and 850,000 BIPS on Thailand. They are all denominated in U.S. dollars.
One BIPS relates to one index.
The BIPS will be exercisable from October 25, 1996 to October 6, 1999 and they will be listed on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.
